scenario: [RCTS.1.2.1]: no object in a fixture, at any depth, repeats a member name, and a harness must refuse one that does. Here the repeat is nested, in `libraries`, and its two values agree: `units.hz` is given twice with the same source. A reader that keeps one binding, as Python's `json` and `dsc.json` both do, sees one well-formed library, and the program would compile against it, so a harness that does not look for repeats reports `accepted`. A harness that compares the values finds nothing to choose between and accepts it too. [RCTS.1.2.15]: the subject is the harness, so it passes only when the harness refuses the fixture under [RCTS.1.2.1], before anything is compiled.
